text:
Linda Park: Heads-up from the nightly link scan: onboarding/index.html in staging has a handful of 404s for examples and one old CLI command. Not a major outage but new hires hit this page. Can someone take a quick look?
Sam O: I can triage. Pinged the scan output.
link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-22T06:05Z - 7 dead internal links found in onboarding/index.html; samples: /examples/old/streaming, /cli/v0/auth; full: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/2955554321
Sam O: looks like we renamed /examples/old/* to /examples/v2/* during the example repo restructure. I can patch.
Linda Park: If you edit, please also update the inline CLI snippet that references `redwood auth --old-flag` -> `redwood auth login` since that flag was removed. Might be worth a tiny changelog line.
Sam O: good catch. local quickfix I ran:
```bash
rg "/examples/old/streaming|cli/v0/auth|redwood auth --old-flag" -n docs/ && \
sed -i 's@/examples/old/@/examples/v2/@g' docs/onboarding/index.html && \
sed -i 's@/cli/v0/auth@/cli/auth@g' docs/onboarding/index.html && \
sed -i 's@redwood auth --old-flag@redwood auth login@g' docs/onboarding/index.html
```
Linda Park: thanks. Can you include the scan link and a one-liner in the PR body mentioning the CLI deprecation? That helps support.
Sam O: will do. Opening PR now and tagging @Linda for reviewer.
docs-oncall: FYI if CI is green and this is small we can merge to get staging fixed before next scan.
Sam O: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7802 - includes path fixes + CLI snippet change + changelog note. Tagging @Linda Park.
Linda Park: quick CR now. small nit: add a short sentence under "Troubleshooting" about the new example path. Otherwise LGTM.
Sam O: pushed the nit fix. CI green. Merging once tests finish.
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge.
Linda Park: great, appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll monitor the re-scan and file a follow-up if anything else shows up.
